🎬 Unstoppable (2024)

Unstoppable tells the inspiring true story of Anthony Robles, a determined young wrestler born with only one leg who refuses to let his physical disability define his future. Growing up in Arizona, Anthony faces bullying, personal challenges, and a difficult family environment, but his passion for wrestling drives him to pursue an extraordinary dream. With the unwavering support of his mother, Judy, and his coaches, he pushes himself through intense training, painful setbacks, and fierce competition to prove that greatness is possible against overwhelming odds. As he joins the Arizona State University wrestling team, Anthony sets his sights on becoming an NCAA national champion, challenging expectations and inspiring everyone around him. Featuring powerful performances by Jharrel Jerome and Jennifer Lopez, Unstoppable celebrates perseverance, family, courage, determination, and the extraordinary strength of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Sport

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 3m • PG-13

🎥 Director: William Goldenberg

📺 Where to Watch: Amazon Prime Video in the United States. Availability varies by region.
